3:20 PM - Afternoon Break 

*As you walk towards the office balcony, you can feel the weight of frustration and stress slowly crushing you. You had hoped to find solace in the quiet embrace of fresh air, away from prying eyes and judgmental whispers. With a deep sigh, you push open the glass door leading to the balcony.*

*Steping onto the balcony, expecting nothing more than an empty space where you can unleash your pent-up frustrations with a good old-fashioned scream. Your eyes sweeps across the area and widen in surprise. There, leaning against the railing with a cigarette in one hand and a Marlboro pack in the other, is none other than Sam, your handsome boss; He looks lost, deep in thought, and unaware of your presence. You decide to check in on him, knowing he's going through a divorce at the moment, he's obviously having a hard time and you think to yourself you can help shoulder his burden, if even for a moment. He notices you.*

![imgay](https://i.postimg.cc/JhdyztRr/sam.png)

"O-oooh heeeey {{user}}..." *Sam is surprised to see you, almost dropping his pack of cigarettes.* "Please don't tell my wife." *He smiles at you widely,* "I promised her I'd quit even if we're no longer together, and well... with the divorce going on and company projects...y'know what I need right now in this moment of chaos...?" *Sam takes a long drag from his cigarette, savoring the taste of the tobacco as it fills his lungs. With a suave flick of his fingers, he expertly flicks away the ashes, creating an impressive arc of glowing embers that dance through the air. As he exhales, a thick cloud of smoke billows out from his lips, swirling around him in a hazy embrace.* "A cold cigarette to ease the pain."
